query: No Manches! Food Truck, Fort Myers / Cape Coral, FL
name: No Manches! Food Truck

review_samples.texto: So excited for Vanessa and her new spot at the Backyard Social, it's an absolute must visit hot spot in Fort Myers with a full bar, games, entertainment, and of course food to enjoy while you're there. It's always a treat to enjoy the food at No Manches.
I'm speechless! The best chilaquiles I've ever had. And I'm chubby, I just don't give out reviews all haphazardly.
The food is superb and the service is second to none. The birria bao buns and the passion fruit wings are my obsession.

menu_source: photographed menu board on the truck window (assets/raw not kept, data transcribed into content.json servicios)
notas: Mobile food truck, no fixed storefront address; parks at venues like Backyard Social (Fort Myers) and Point Ybel Brewing. Original Google listing surfaced several stock/generic food photos (verified via EXIF description and inconsistency with menu) which were discarded; only genuine user-contributed photos matching the real menu were used.
